title: tests/app_identity links fail under LICHEN_IPV6=n on pubkey_to_iid/ygg_addr
description: Pre-existing breakage (not introduced by 84dfe84451), found while verifying project-LICHEN-worker6-6fg3 on AWS waves-base (native_sim/native/64, CONFIG_LICHEN_IPV6=n CONFIG_LICHEN_LINK=y): tests/app_identity/src/main.c:69,162 calls lichen_key_pubkey_to_iid (defined only in coap/coap_keys_format.c:267, built only under CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_KEYS) and subsys/lichen/app_identity/app_identity.c:47,125,251 calls lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519 (defined only in l2/ipv6_addr.c:378, built only under CONFIG_LICHEN_IPV6). GNU ld therefore rejects zephyr.exe on those two symbols even after the lichen_hash_32 fix lands. Options: move pubkey_to_iid/ygg_addr derivations into an always-built TU, or make the test enable the subsystems it exercises (contradicts its IPV6=n purpose), or stub at the test boundary. The lichen_hash_32 symbol itself is resolved by worker6-6fg3 (absent from the final link error list).
notes: Fixed app_identity's invalid link-time dependencies on CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_KEYS and CONFIG_LICHEN_IPV6 by deriving the canonical SHA-512 IID/Yggdrasil addresses in its own always-built source. Kconfig now selects Monocypher because app_identity directly uses its constant-time compare and SHA-512. Removed optional coap_keys test dependency; added fixed IID/Ygg vectors and explicit IPv6-off/on Twister cases via ipv6_on.conf. Local Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 evidence: IPv6 off (# CONFIG_LICHEN_IPV6 is not set), compile/link PASS and runtime 6/6 PASS; IPv6 on (CONFIG_LICHEN_IPV6=y), compile/link PASS and runtime 6/6 PASS. Reconfigured/relinked both after final Kconfig change. Builds used only -Wno-error=duplicated-branches to bypass a Zephyr-4.1 cbprintf false positive in unrelated shared link/L2 logging; app_identity compiled under project strict warnings. nm confirmed app_identity has neither lichen_key_pubkey_to_iid nor lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519 undefined in either configuration. Twister discovery lists 12 cases (6 per feature configuration). git diff --check PASS.
